entities.summary: David Zalkaliani is a Georgian politician and career diplomat who served as the Ambassador of Georgia to the United States from April 4, 2022 until November 30, 2024. From June 21, 2018 to April 4, 2022 he served as the Minister of Foreign Affairs of Georgia. From January 21, 2021 to April 4, 2022 he was also Deputy Prime Minister of Georgia.
